info.name: HubSpot Analytics Events Access Tokens Definition Revisions API

params.name: appId
params.description: The unique identifier of the HubSpot application

params.name: definitionId
params.description: The unique identifier of the action definition

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return per page

params.name: after
params.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of results

items.docs:
Retrieves a paginated list of all revisions for a custom action definition. 
Each revision represents a snapshot of the action definition at a point in time.

params.name: appId
params.description: The unique identifier of the HubSpot application

params.name: definitionId
params.description: The unique identifier of the action definition

params.name: revisionId
params.description: The unique identifier of the revision

items.docs:
Retrieves a specific revision of a custom action definition by its revision ID. 
This allows you to view the action definition as it existed at a particular point in time.
